summary: The filing is a Form 8-K by Benchmark 2025-V16 Mortgage Trust, a commercial mortgage ABS issuer, reporting a servicing transfer. Effective September 1, 2026, Greystone Servicing Company LLC sold its special servicing division assets to C-IV Asset Management LLC, which assumed duties as special servicer under the related PSA. The registrant filed the Assignment and Assumption Agreement as an exhibit. No special-situation event is involved; this is a routine operational disclosure regarding a servicing arrangement. There is no impact on security holders beyond administrative continuity, so the appropriate classification is None.
